data.name: Hasen
data.gender_notes: Hasen is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Hasen is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘haṣa’, which means 'to laugh' or 'to make laugh'. This name is associated with joy, happiness, and merriment. In Hindu mythology, Hasen is believed to bring laughter and lightness to any situation. The name Hasen carries the meaning “Laughter, Joy” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Hasen usually hope their child will grow to embody laughter, joy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Name of the Hindu deity, Lord Hasi, who embodies joy and happiness.
data.etymology: Hasen belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Laughter, Joy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hasen total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
